# FAQ

## How far in advance should I book my move?

There's no strict rule — it depends on our availability for your desired move day.

HANDLING: Encourage booking early if move date is flexible-sensitive

## Are my belongings insured during the move?

Yes, basic liability coverage is included at no extra cost. We don't offer any additional coverage tiers.

HANDLING: Consistent with P10 - reworded for how customers actually ask

## Can I help with the move to save money?

We generally prefer our professional movers handle all loading and unloading, for safety and insurance reasons. You can save money by having small items already packed and ready to go before the crew arrives.

## What items can't you move?

We cannot transport hazardous materials (e.g. paint, propane tanks), pets, or firearms.

## How do I get a precise quote for a long-distance move?

We recommend a virtual or in-person consultation so we can accurately assess your inventory and needs. For smaller moves, you can also just send photos of the items.

## What happens if there's a delay in my move?

We aim to stick to scheduled timelines. If there's an unforeseen delay, we'll communicate with you right away and give updated timelines and solutions to minimize inconvenience.

## Do you offer any discounts?

We offer a 5% discount to returning or referred customers, as well as veterans and those on active military duty.

HANDLING: Source sentence was cut off after 'We do not change' - confirm with Nik/office whether discounts are non-stackable or something else before publishing

## If I don't need a truck, is the rate cheaper?

No — our rates are already kept below market and can't be lowered even if a truck isn't needed. The published rates are final.

## How many movers should I get?

Typically: 2 movers for a studio or 1-bedroom, 3 movers for a 2-bedroom or small office, 4 movers for 3+ bedrooms or a medium-size office. For anything bigger, reach out so we can figure out the best option together. If you have a lot of items, more movers is usually worth it.

## Are there any hidden fees (stairs, long carries, fuel, etc.)?

The only additional fees beyond the base rate are: Double Drive Time (if the distance between your two locations is over 15 miles), extra packing materials like bubble wrap or boxes, and excessively heavy items (typically 150+ lbs) - contact our office to check if that applies to you.

## Do you offer flat rates?

Flat rates are only for long-distance / out-of-state moves. Local moves are hourly.

## What happens if something breaks during the move?

If our movers break something, we're happy to issue compensation on top of the basic valuation coverage already included ($0.60/lb per item). The exact payout depends on the item, the damage, and the circumstances.

HANDLING: Escalate specific payout amounts to office

## How does payment work at the end of the move?

At the end of the move, the team foreman calculates the total and presents it to you. Cash payments are collected directly by the foreman; card payments are handled via a payment link sent by our office.

## Do you charge extra for a long carry to the truck?

No extra charge, but keep in mind the move may take longer if it's a long walking distance to the truck (since you're billed hourly).

## Will I get a call before the team arrives?

Yes, the team foreman will call or text you before arriving.

## Do I need to empty out my drawers before the move?

Yes, we strongly recommend it - especially for large or heavy furniture pieces, and if stairs are involved.
